code:
import itertools, math, functools, json, os, time
P=1000003

def parts(n,lo=1):
 if not n:
  yield ()
 else:
  for a in range(lo,n+1):
   for t in parts(n-a,a):yield (a,)+t

def oddfact(n):
 r=1
 for a in range(1,n+1,2):r=r*a%P
 return r
invdf={i:pow(oddfact(2*i+1),-1,P) for i in range(24)}
@functools.lru_cache(None)
def blocks_poly(t):
 if not t:return (1,)
 first=t[0]
 rem=t[1:]
 distinct=sorted(set(rem))
 counts=[rem.count(x) for x in distinct]
 out=[0]*(len(t)+1)
 for sel in itertools.product(*[range(c+1) for c in counts]):
  total=first+sum(a*b for a,b in zip(distinct,sel))
  size=1+sum(sel)
  multiplicity=math.prod(math.comb(a,b) for a,b in zip(counts,sel))
  coeff=multiplicity*invdf[total]*(-1 if size%2==0 else 1)%P
  leftover=tuple(x for x,c,k in zip(distinct,counts,sel) for _ in range(c-k))
  f=blocks_poly(leftover)
  for k,v in enumerate(f):out[k+1]=(out[k+1]+coeff*v)%P
 return tuple(out)
const=oddfact(49)*pow(math.factorial(49)%P,-1,P)%P
facts=[math.factorial(47+k)%P for k in range(24)]
def integral(t):return const*sum(v*facts[k] for k,v in enumerate(blocks_poly(t)))%P
rows=list(parts(12));cols=list(parts(11))
print('sizes',len(rows),len(cols),flush=True)
t=time.time()
M=[[integral(tuple(sorted(a+b))) for b in cols] for a in rows]
print('computed',time.time()-t,blocks_poly.cache_info(),flush=True)
N=[r[:] for r in M];piv=[];r=0
for j in range(len(cols)):
 i=next((i for i in range(r,len(rows)) if N[i][j]),None)
 if i is None:continue
 N[r],N[i]=N[i],N[r]
 inv=pow(N[r][j],-1,P);N[r]=[v*inv%P for v in N[r]]
 for i in range(r+1,len(rows)):
  c=N[i][j]
  if c:N[i]=[(a-c*b)%P for a,b in zip(N[i],N[r])]
 piv.append(j);r+=1
print('rank',r,'pivcols',piv)
os.makedirs('workspace',exist_ok=True)
json.dump({'prime':P,'rows':rows,'cols':cols,'matrix':M,'rank':r,'pivcols':piv},open('workspace/pairing25_agent4.json','w'))

from fractions import Fraction
import itertools,math,functools,json,time,pickle
import sympy as s
from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
D=json.load(open('workspace/pairing25_agent4.json'))
def oddfact(n):return math.prod(range(1,n+1,2))
invdf={i:Fraction(1,oddfact(2*i+1)) for i in range(24)}
@functools.lru_cache(None)
def poly(t):
 if not t:return (Fraction(1),)
 first=t[0];rem=t[1:];distinct=sorted(set(rem));counts=[rem.count(x) for x in distinct];out=[Fraction(0)]*(len(t)+1)
 for sel in itertools.product(*[range(c+1) for c in counts]):
  total=first+sum(a*b for a,b in zip(distinct,sel));size=1+sum(sel)
  c=math.prod(math.comb(a,b) for a,b in zip(counts,sel))*invdf[total]*(-1 if size%2==0 else 1)
  leftover=tuple(x for x,m,k in zip(distinct,counts,sel) for _ in range(m-k))
  for k,v in enumerate(poly(leftover)):out[k+1]+=c*v
 return tuple(out)
const=Fraction(oddfact(49),math.factorial(49));facts=[math.factorial(47+k) for k in range(24)]
def integral(t):return const*sum(v*facts[k] for k,v in enumerate(poly(t)))
start=time.time();basis=D['rows'][33:]
A=[[integral(tuple(sorted(a+b))) for a in basis] for b in D['cols']]
print('exact pairing done',time.time()-start,flush=True)
DM=DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(s.Matrix(A)).to_field()
ker=DM.nullspace().to_Matrix();print('kernel computed',ker.shape,time.time()-start,flush=True)
v=list(ker[0,:]);den=s.ilcm(*[x.q for x in v]);v=[int(x*den) for x in v];gc=math.gcd(*v);v=[x//gc for x in v]
print('kernel primitive',list(zip(basis,v)),flush=True)
assert len(ker.tolist())==1
assert all(sum(a*b for a,b in zip(row,v))==0 for row in A)
json.dump({'basis':basis,'coefficients':v},open('workspace/radical25_agent4.json','w'))
pickle.dump(A,open('workspace/pairing25_free_exact_agent4.pkl','wb'))
open('workspace/radical25_agent4.py','w').write(open(__file__).read())

from collections import Counter,defaultdict
import math,time,json
P=1000000007;G=25;PSI=(0,-2)
def prod(mon,vs):
 coeff=1;out=list(mon)
 for i,j in vs:
  if (i,j)==PSI:out.append((i,j));continue
  if i<0 or j<0 or i>j+2 or (i+j)%2:return None,0
  if i==j==0:coeff=coeff*G%P
  else:out.append((i,j))
 return tuple(sorted(out)),coeff

def deriv(poly):
 out=defaultdict(int)
 for mon,coef in poly.items():
  c=Counter(mon); keys=[v for v in c if v[0]>0]
  for a,(i,j) in enumerate(keys):
   n=c[i,j];rest=list(mon);rest.remove((i,j))
   dest,w=prod(rest,[(i-2,j)])
   if w:out[dest]=(out[dest]+coef*n*w)%P
   for k,l in keys[a:]:
    m=c[k,l]-(i==k and j==l)
    if m<=0:continue
    factor=n*m*(pow(2,-1,P) if (i,j)==(k,l) else 1)%P
    rest2=rest[:];rest2.remove((k,l))
    dest,w=prod(rest2,[PSI,(i-1,j-1),(k-1,l-1)])
    if w:out[dest]=(out[dest]+coef*factor*w)%P
    dest,w=prod(rest2,[(i+k-2,j+l)])
    if w:out[dest]=(out[dest]-coef*factor*math.comb(i+k-2,i-1)*w)%P
 return {k:v for k,v in out.items() if v}
initial=[(4,2)]*12+[(2,0)]*2
poly={tuple(sorted(initial)):1}
t=time.time()
for r in range(26):
 poly=deriv(poly)
 print(r+1,len(poly),round(time.time()-t,2),flush=True)
json.dump([[k,v] for k,v in poly.items()],open('workspace/agent3_jacobian_test.json','w'))
open('workspace/agent3_jacobian_test.py','w').write(open(__file__).read())

import math,time,json
P=1000000007;G=25;PSI=(0,-2)
def prod(mon,vs):
 coeff=1;out=list(mon)
 for i,j in vs:
  if (i,j)==PSI:out.append((i,j));continue
  if i<0 or j<0 or i>j+2 or (i+j)%2:return None,0
  if i==j==0:coeff=coeff*G%P
  else:out.append((i,j))
 return tuple(sorted(out)),coeff

def deriv(poly):

 for mon,coef in poly.items():
  c=Counter(mon); keys=[v for v in c if v[0]>0]
  for a,(i,j) in enumerate(keys):
   n=c[i,j];rest=list(mon);rest.remove((i,j))
   dest,w=prod(rest,[(i-2,j)])
